commentary_title: Market activity sees an uptick in mid-week
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index increased in week 37, ending at 89 points. For most of the year, the index has followed last year's trend, albeit being lower overall. As a result, it will likely continue to increase next week. | The week started off quietly, but picked up in the middle as freight rates picked up in tandem with increased market activity towards the Med. | The %laden increased in both the East and the West, and current market conditions will likely prevail next week, pushing up rates further.
